modules.name: windows_artifact_triage
modules.live_check: V3LUM_LIVE=1 tests/live/test_p2_g12_3.py: 7 passed (2026-11-26, also with LnkParse3/olefile/pymsi installed in a scratch path). Offline module, so the harness downloads 4 real LNKs from LnkParse3's MIT test suite (raw.githubusercontent.com) plus the JSON LnkParse3 expects for them: the built-in [MS-SHLLINK] reader matches LnkParse3 on header flags/times, StringData, LinkInfo, tracker block and size (it reads the BEEF0004 long names where LnkParse3 gives 8.3 names); the module runs on them with no request (the real cmd.exe .vbs dropper sample is flagged, the private-address share is MEDIUM). PyPI metadata of LnkParse3 1.6.0, olefile 0.47 and pymsi 0.0.0rc1: pins published, permissive licences, no advisory.

core_requests: core/sandbox.py (P269 c2 / P367 c2): run `windows_artifact_triage.child_entry(fmt, data, use_extras=...)` in the python -I child with rlimits (memory <= 1 GiB, CPU, RLIMIT_FSIZE 0), wall timeout, 100 MB input / 1 MB JSON output caps, and have doctor report the reduced isolation on Windows. Until then the module parses in process (module files may not start processes, LINT-01) and the optional LnkParse3/olefile/pymsi run in process when installed (setting windows_artifact_triage_use_extras=false disables them).

P375 sightings (WP16 store): index the LNK clustering identifiers (keyword entities 'lnk_machine_id:', 'lnk_droid_mac:', 'lnk_volume_serial:' or the attributes lnk_machine_id/lnk_droid_mac/lnk_volume_serial) as clustering keys so Grandoreiro/Mekotio-style campaigns link across cases (P367 c7); keywords are not IOC_TYPES today, so they get no sightings rows. legal_dpo to decide whether these device identifiers are indexed as the keyed HMAC (A4 style).

Policy gate (WP07): a 'no_lookup' rule for the lnk_* clustering keywords that refuses them to every module with disclosure other than 'none' even when an analyst selects them (P367 c7 'never sent to any lookup'); today only expand=False + NO_AUTO_EXPAND(keyword) protect them.

ModuleResult.pivot tags (same request as p1-G12-1): let modules tag pivot entities 'hostile'/'never_fetch' so the P376 guard and exporters read them directly; remote LNK/MSI targets now rely on relation + note + the FILE-provenance hostile-shape rule (GUARD-01).

v3lum.core.ioc.extract (P172): decode PowerShell -EncodedCommand (UTF-16LE base64) or let P366 feed decoded layers to it; documentation-range IPs are flagged 'bogon' when bare but not when inside a URL (inconsistent expand).

P366 script_decoder (batch p2-G12-2): keep the prep API `decode_layers(text, *, redact=...) -> {'layers': [{'n','technique','label','text',...}], 'path', 'stop'}`; windows_artifact_triage calls it through importlib when the module exists and falls back to a bounded stand-in otherwise.

Thread-safe warning capture for in-process third-party parsers: warnings.catch_warnings is process-global; the module serialises its LnkParse3 calls with a lock (another module's warning raised in that window is recorded there). Disappears with the sandbox.
notes: P367 delivered as one offline module (disclosure none, terms open, tier n/a, TLP:RED, FILE only, default_enabled True, max_requests 0, no provider/hosts/keys). Applicability uses the shared file_type_sniff routing table; a damaged artefact keeps its .lnk/.one/.onetoc2/.msi/.msm/.msp/.mst format by extension so it ends ERROR, never skipped/empty (c5). LNK: LnkParse3 when installed, else (or when it fails) a built-in [MS-SHLLINK] reader with the same report shape; StringData is always re-read with the full counts because LnkParse3 1.6.0 silently misreads strings after a field longer than 260 chars. OneNote: own FileDataStoreObject scan (pyOneNote unused), embedded files hashed in memory as sha256 'contains' pivots, names bound heuristically. MSI: olefile when installed, else the bounded built-in [MS-CFB] reader of file_type_sniff (+ document_metadata.ole_summary) for streams/summary; CustomAction/Binary/Property tables only via the optional pymsi, otherwise 'MSI tables not parsed (...)' (INFO finding, status OK). Scripts/command lines go to P366 when installed (decode_layers), else a bounded stand-in (-EncodedCommand, FromBase64String); decoded text goes to core ioc.extract; namespace/CDN hosts dropped. UNC/WebDAV/URL targets become hostile pivots (lnk_target/lnk_icon/lnk_reference/msi_reference, WebDAV UNC also as the derived https URL), never contacted; plain SMB shares on RFC1918/NetBIOS hosts are MEDIUM instead of HIGH. Machine id/droid MAC/volume serial are attributes + keyword pivots expand=False (relation lnk_metadata). Severity table is a proposal (final conditions fix none), worded 'suspicious'. Sandbox (c2) and P375 indexing (c7) need core work: see core_requests and docs/backlog/p2-G12-3.md. No LIGHT/ACTIVE variant requested. Tests: 76 module tests (tests/modules/test_windows_artifact_triage.py) + 46 builder/cross-check tests (tests/modules/test_p2_g12_3.py; 8 skip without the optional parsers, all 46 pass with LnkParse3 1.6.0, olefile 0.47 and pymsi 0.0.0rc1 installed in a scratch path, which also confirmed the captured real-library fixtures). A mutation fuzz (5,200 mutated LNK/OneNote/MSI inputs through child_entry+analyse, 300 through the full engine run in strict mode) raised nothing: damaged inputs end ERROR with a parse reason. The prep material (notes, parsers, builders, captured child reports) was used: builders ported to tests/modules/test_p2_g12_3.py, child reports copied to tests/fixtures/windows_artifact_triage/ after a personal-data/key scan. No earlier partial files of this batch existed. Full offline suite (2026-11-26): 25 failures, none in this batch's files; after one re-run 7 remain, all owned by other in-progress batches/core (pivots_crypto/chainabuse links, typosquat BCB dataset text, axfr fixtures, dns_bruteforce notice, rule_api legacy flags, a timing-based lint-pattern test). tests/test_registry_contract.py is green for windows_artifact_triage; ruff and the P327 lint are clean on every batch file.
